dateAssessment: May 24 is spoken in the transcript; the year 1749 comes from YAML. The completed overnight at t07 and dawn at t09 place the expedition on **May 25**, conditional on that starting date. This conflicts with YAML drEnd = 1749-05-24. The source chronology is retained throughout these rows. The pre-teleport short rest is confirmed retrospectively; its exact watch is unrecorded and it is listed with the opening it precedes. Sura’s western noon is a separate local clock; the DM’s rough 1–3 p.m. Drankor conversion crosses the midday/afternoon boundary. Future prison-release countdowns do not establish elapsed time or a resolved release date.

watches.summary: Vindristjarna was turned around “this morning”; its later distance remains a forecast.
Opening about 11 a.m.; the prior ship short rest is confirmed, with its clock unspecified.
Ceasefire shortly before western noon; the DM loosely equates this to 1–3 p.m. in Drankor.
Afternoon debate reaches sunset dinner; renewed feast falls near 9 p.m. from its next-day expiry.
Completed overnight long rest; eight-hour convention and the following dawn support these endpoints.
The next morning dawns; the party leaves the sanctuary.
Thirty minutes to the rim; later one-minute pact restoration before entering the hall.
